title: Credential containment and deployment security

subtasks.description: Give credential owners the safe path/history inventory; revoke/rotate affected credentials through their approved process and review provider usage.
subtasks.progress_note: Safe, value-free credential-family inventory (CF-01..CF-07) and per-owner runbook prepared in docs/security/credential-containment-record.md; revocation/rotation and usage review require the credential owners.

subtasks.description: Identify copied artifacts/forks/caches and prepare a separately approved history-cleanup plan; preserve incident evidence.
subtasks.progress_note: Copied-artifact/fork/cache inventory checklist and history-cleanup outline drafted; the inventory itself (ZIPs, forks, clones, images, caches) has not been executed and the cleanup needs separate approval.

subtasks.description: Replace embedded/default credentials with secret references and mandatory secure production settings.
Enable redacted secret scanning for new commits, full release content, image layers and support bundles.
subtasks.progress_note: Scanning plan drafted (product history, hooks, release content, image layers, support bundles, allowlist, zero-unreviewed gate); only the existing outer-repository Gitleaks CI job exists today.

subtasks.description: Configure actual ingress TLS, internal network exposure limits and database/object/backup encryption with key rotation ownership.
Test invalid production configuration, exposed service ports, log redaction and certificate/key renewal on the supported topology.

dependency_note: Credential containment can start immediately; actual rotation needs the credential owner. No credentials were tested or rotated in this handoff.
